notes.title: Hey, I'm back with something new – try Dustoria!
notes.content:
[p][b]Hey everyone![/b] 👋[/p][p]I released a demo for my new game: [b]Dustoria[/b] 🌵
It's a calm and minimalist survival-builder set in a forgotten desert.
[/p][p]If you enjoyed my previous games, I’d love for you to try it out and share your thoughts.
Every bit of feedback helps a lot during this early phase![/p][p]🎮 [b]Play the demo on Steam now:[/b][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3745010/Dustoria_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]
💬 Drop your thoughts, I’m reading everything![/p][p]Thanks for sticking around ❤️[/p]

notes.title: Late Night Drift
notes.content:
[b]As some of you know, Late Night Drive is a game developed in a short time, I made it as a social media content, but it attracted a lot of attention, so I decided to make a new game by taking the feedback from this game, the new game will be drift-oriented and will have more realistic graphics, do not forget to express your ideas and opinions. notes.title: Weekly Update (v0.20)
notes.content:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44157065/052fda1c3dce9726073eb5a515093e0fa2c1dacf.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44157065/978074b2daf16a65919c3a2b3945696dd2a48e8e.png[/img][/url]
[list]
[*]Car manager doesn't close when pause menu is closed.
[*]Radio play pause broken on starfall city map
[*]Settings are not visible for people who join the lobby later.
[*]Moving the camera while the mouse-controlled steering wheel is on makes the steering wheel move.
[*]Anime girl disappears after therapy [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U3DCRmB6cYg]**Fixed**[/url]
[/list]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44157065/a85dd035d0564ef927b036eb48ffa4723f604e17.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44157065/123d044193f16f49d35ae08cc422d09c66ae9f5e.png[/img][/url]
[list]
[*]npc cars are now affected by physics.
[*]NPC cars now stop and turn on hazard lights when they crash.
[*]Cruise control added.
[*]Rain mode added.
[*]Added height adjustment for front and rear suspension.
[*]Now the car really explodes when you lose in bomb mode.
[*]Drift mode can now be played in online mode.
[*]Added Speed Sensitive steering (steering angle gets smaller as the speed of the vehicle increases)
[*]2 new music. (Brewed Melodies and Stormy Rhythms)
[*]1 New Car.
[/list]


[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44157065/11ee6c0707a6210e9e8a61afe74fe66a5e58c7a8.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44157065/9e22e1735bad9987afd3afd03eb0ad520bc65497.png[/img][/url]
[list]
[*]Edited the key settings menu, made it more readable.
[/list]

notes.title: Weekly Update (v0.19)
notes.content:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44157065/052fda1c3dce9726073eb5a515093e0fa2c1dacf.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44157065/978074b2daf16a65919c3a2b3945696dd2a48e8e.png[/img][/url]
[list]
[*]Fog doesn't affect the sky box in online maps.
[*]Horn not working in singleplayer.
[*]Side mirrors show mirrors of other players
[*]Car accelerates, when you let off the gas.
[/list]


[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44157065/a85dd035d0564ef927b036eb48ffa4723f604e17.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44157065/123d044193f16f49d35ae08cc422d09c66ae9f5e.png[/img][/url]
[list]
[*]Race track map. (This map takes place at morning hours because too many players asked for it)
[*]2 new music. (Electro Dimension and Latte Groove)
[*]VSync setting.
[*]Lobby chat added.
[*]Kick player command added (/kc "Player ID") (The player id is written next to the player's name)
[*]Suspension settings added
[*]Earning money from game modes added.
[*]Car now drives slowly on the sand.
[*]If the traffic density is 0, the achievements will be disabled.
[*]Smoke and tire tracks now appear when the vehicle is drifting.
[*]Ability to buy cars added. 
[*]2 New Cars. 
[*]Steering sensitivity setting added.
[*]If the vehicle turns upside down, there is now a text that tells you how to fix it.
[*]Now if you fall off the map the game throws you back to the map.
[*]A counter has been added to the main menu that displays the remaining time until the next update.
[/list]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44157065/11ee6c0707a6210e9e8a61afe74fe66a5e58c7a8.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44157065/9e22e1735bad9987afd3afd03eb0ad520bc65497.png[/img][/url]
[list]
[*]Npc cars no longer spawns on the first chunk in online mode.
[*]The handling characteristics of the vehicles have been slightly adjusted.
[/list]

[h2]If you want to report a bug, you can join to our discord server.[/h2]
[url=https://discord.gg/thtbUty6yG][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44157065/26456b55339b367e0a47f8fea4d324e3bf608433.png[/img][/url]
